title: 第21章 全灭第22章 生命源晶
slug: 精灵族的修仙者第342章巢穴
content_zh:
两三百头蜥蜴人同时发起冲锋，嘶吼声震耳欲聋，场面骇人至极。
附近的精灵们无不倒吸一口凉气，面上齐齐露出骇然之色。
“快救人！”
虽然看不惯安东平日里的举止，但关键时刻，还是艾莉诺最先反应过来，她大喊一声，举起手中法杖，晦涩的咒语从口中吐出，淡青色的魔力光辉在杖尖急速汇聚。
周围的精灵如梦初醒，纷纷出手准备救援。
光幕前的菲恩和罗莎琳也变了脸色，当机立断传讯，命令就近的卫兵火速赶往洼地。
众人之中，唯独罗曼依旧神色如常，站在原地没有动弹。
她对安东不要太了解，很清楚后者绝不会做没有把握的事情，既然敢把蜥蜴人引到这里，肯定已经有了应对之策。
而支持她这一判断的，还有安东那即便身陷重围，也依旧云淡风轻的神色。
果不其然。
下一瞬，就见安东猛地张口，发出一声龙吟般的清啸。
那啸声与先前的声音截然不同，更加高亢、尖锐，带着某种摄人心魄的诡异力量。
刹那间，无数有若实质的音波涟漪骤然浮现，以他为中心向四面八方席卷开来。
空气仿佛被无形的巨手搅动，呈现出肉眼可见的扭曲波纹。
正朝洼地冲去的精灵们脚步陡然一个踉跄，只觉体内气血沸涌，脑袋一阵昏沉。
一些实力较弱的精灵，更是脸色煞白，身形摇晃，不得不倚着树木才没有倒下。
连距离较远的他们都如此，更别说身处音波攻击中心的蜥蜴人了。
音波涟漪所过之处，冲刺中的蜥蜴人一瞬间仿佛迎面撞上一堵巨墙，身体不由自主地向后倒飞摔出，五脏六腑仿佛全压作了一处，鲜血贯出鼻膜咽喉，刹那间漫天酾红。
嘭嘭嘭！
一头头蜥蜴人接连倒飞而出，重重摔落在地。

有的捂着脑袋疯狂翻滚，发出凄厉的惨嚎。
更多的则是落地后便再无声息，殷红的鲜血从口鼻耳窍中缓缓流出，在身下汇聚成一片片触目惊心的血泊。
短短数个呼吸，洼地里就已经躺满了蜥蜴人的尸骸。
缓过气来的精灵们目光呆滞地看着眼前这一幕，只觉口舌干涩，张大嘴巴久久没回过神来。
艾莉诺更是满心震撼，手中法杖险些滑落。
即便是早有所料的罗曼，看着眼前的情形也忍不住吃惊地瞪大眼眸。
这是什么招数？
安东以前可没在她面前用过！
光幕前的菲恩和罗莎琳也呆愣在了原地，脸上写满震惊与难以置信。
“刚才......那是什么？”罗莎琳嘴唇微微颤动。
菲恩没有回答，他同样没见过如此怪异而霸道的战技。
更让他心惊的，还是安东此时所展露出来的力量。
他看得分明，刚才那一击过后，除了黑铁位阶的蜥蜴人精锐，其余蜥蜴人几乎死了个一干二净。
一击秒杀近两百头蜥蜴人，就算是白银阶施法者来了，也不一定能做到。
洼地中央，安东面色依旧平静无波，就好像刚才不是杀死了数以百计的蜥蜴人，只是拂去了一片落叶。
他从地上拔起黑钢剑，目光扫过周围残存的黑铁阶蜥蜴人精锐。
它们此刻正摇晃着爬起身。
伤痛没有吓退它们，反而彻底激发了它们的凶性，嘶吼着再次向安东发起冲锋，黄色的竖瞳中燃烧着暴虐与疯狂。
安东夷然不惧，身形一闪，如鬼魅般迎了上去。
凛冽剑光厉电般撕裂虚空，两头冲得最前的蜥蜴人身形一滞，脑袋已斜斜飞起，滚烫的鲜血喷涌而出。
content_en:
Two to three hundred lizardmen charged at the same time, the roar was deafening, and the scene was extremely terrifying.
The elves nearby all took a deep breath, with looks of horror on their faces.
"Hurry and save people!"
Although she couldn't understand Anton's usual behavior, at the critical moment, Eleanor was the first to react. She shouted, raised her staff, and spit out obscure spells from her mouth, and the light cyan magic light quickly gathered at the tip of the staff.
The elves around him seemed to be waking up from a dream, and they all took action to prepare for rescue.
Finn and Rosalin in front of the light curtain also changed their expressions. They immediately sent a message and ordered the nearby guards to rush to the depression.
Among everyone, Roman was the only one who still looked as normal and stood there without moving.
She didn't know Anton too well. She knew very well that the latter would never do anything he was unsure of. Since he dared to lead the lizard man here, he must have already had a countermeasure.
What supported her judgment was Anton's calm expression even though he was surrounded by heavy siege.
Sure enough.
The next moment, Anton suddenly opened his mouth and let out a clear roar like a dragon's roar.
The howling sound was completely different from the previous sound. It was higher-pitched and sharp, carrying some kind of soul-stirring and strange power.
In an instant, countless substantial sound wave ripples suddenly emerged, sweeping out in all directions with him as the center.
The air seemed to be stirred by invisible giant hands, showing twisted ripples visible to the naked eye.
The elves who were rushing towards the depression staggered suddenly, feeling their blood boiling in their bodies and their heads feeling dizzy.
Some of the weaker elves turned pale, swayed, and had to lean on trees to keep from falling.
This is true even for them who are far away, let alone the lizard man who is at the center of the sonic attack.
Wherever the sound wave ripples passed, the sprinting lizard man seemed to have hit a huge wall head-on for an instant, and his body involuntarily flew backwards and fell out. His internal organs seemed to be compressed in one place, and blood gushed out of his nose and throat, and the sky was filled with red for an instant.
Bang bang bang!
Lizardmen flew out one after another and fell heavily to the ground.
Some covered their heads and rolled wildly, letting out shrill howls.
Most of them were silent after landing, and bright red blood slowly flowed out from their mouths, noses, and ears, gathering into shocking pools of blood underneath them.
In just a few breaths, the depression was filled with lizard-man corpses.
The elves who had recovered their breath looked at the scene in front of them with dull eyes, their mouths were dry and their mouths were wide open for a long time before they regained consciousness.
Eleanor was even more shocked, and the staff in her hand almost slipped.
Even Roman, who had expected it, couldn't help but widen his eyes in surprise when he saw the situation in front of him.
What kind of trick is this?
Anton had never used it in front of her before!
Finn and Rosalin in front of the light curtain were also stunned on the spot, with shock and disbelief written on their faces.
"Just...what was that?" Rosalin's lips trembled slightly.
Finn did not answer. He had never seen such a weird and domineering combat skill.
What frightened him even more was the power Anton displayed at this time.
He could clearly see that after the blow just now, except for the elite lizardmen of the black iron rank, almost all the other lizardmen were dead.
Killing nearly two hundred lizardmen in one blow, even if a silver-level spellcaster came, he might not be able to do it.
In the center of the depression, Anton's expression remained calm, as if he had just brushed away a fallen leaf instead of killing hundreds of lizardmen.
He pulled out the black steel sword from the ground and glanced at the remaining elite black iron-level lizardmen around him.
They were now swaying to their feet.
The pain did not scare them away, but instead completely aroused their ferocity. They roared and charged at Anton again, with violence and madness burning in their yellow vertical pupils.
Anton was not afraid, and he stepped forward like a ghost.
The sharp sword light tore through the void like lightning,The lizard man who was charging forward at the two ends stagnated, his head flew up sideways, and hot blood spurted out.
